155 pets take flight. 🐾✈️

On November 19 in Merced County, California, volunteers worked through heavy rain to load 100 dogs and 55 cats aboard an Alpine Air Express cargo plane bound for rescue partners. As the last animals went aboard, a rainbow appeared over the runway.

New Beginnings for Merced County Animals organized the effort, and local donors sponsored travel crates. From the folks hauling crates in the rain to the crew flying them out, that’s a team worth cheering for.

Source: KMPH FOX26, reporting on November 23 with details from New Beginnings for Merced County Animals.
